_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With zero volatility in 35 of 35 windows and no liquidity or vol catalyst visible, the coil holds at Denial until a breaker confirms — HOLD is the skilled call, not a passive one.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward call is HOLD (medium conviction) while narrative implies an impending breakout to disbelief; the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) tips the consensus to HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity breaks above 20 AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 85, signaling accumulation deployment.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 22 AND DXY breaks 101 simultaneously, or ETF flows collapse below 60 — institutional exit kills the coil to the downside.
